title: On Forgetting the way home in the dark
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：forget　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 forget 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the foreman ① forgot the way home in the dark without complaint, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② forgets the way home in the dark with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ forget the way home in the dark at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ forgotten the way home in the dark before — a line in the sheet for May 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Forgetting the way home in the dark without complaint, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ forget her birthday three years running with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Forget her birthday three years running at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ forgets her birthday three years running without complaint every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ forgot the way home in the dark again when nobody else would.

⑩ To forget the way home in the dark, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody forgets the way home in the dark with great care again and somebody must forget the way home in the dark without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 忘记（一般过去式 forgot the way home in the dark：1951 年工头头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 忘记（一般现在 forgets the way home in the dark：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 忘记（不定式 to forget the way home in the dark：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 忘记（过去完成时 had forgotten the way home in the dark：1945 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 忘记（动名词 forgetting the way home in the dark 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 忽略（forget her birthday three years running：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去忽略连着三年忘了她的生日）
G. v. 忽略（forget her birthday three years running：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 忘记（后段两处：新来的工人照例 forgets her birthday three years running，而母亲又一次 forgot the way home in the dark）

answers.why: forget 意为“忘记”，1951 年工头毫无怨言地忘记黑地里忘了回家的路，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 forgot。
forget 意为“忘记”，自那以后工头小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 forgets。
forget 意为“忘记”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯忘记黑地里忘了回家的路”，此处为不定式 to forget the way home in the dark。
forget 意为“忘记”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人忘记过，故用过去完成时 had forgotten。
forget 意为“忘记”，工头说“忘记黑地里忘了回家的路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 forgetting the way home in the dark 作主语。
forget 意为“忽略”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去忽略连着三年忘了她的生日”，should ever 之后用原形 forget her birthday three years running。
forget 意为“忽略”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻忽略连着三年忘了她的生日（forget her birthday three years running at once），以后再也不要提起。
forget 意为“忘记”，新来的工人每个班次都照例忽略连着三年忘了她的生日，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 forgets。
forget 意为“忘记”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地忘记黑地里忘了回家的路，用一般过去式 forgot 叙述。
forget 意为“忘记”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要忘记黑地里忘了回家的路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 forget 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the foreman forgot the way home in the dark without complaint, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman forgets the way home in the dark with great care whenever the site asks.
Forgetting the way home in the dark without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever forget her birthday three years running with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site forgets her birthday three years running without complaint every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother forgot the way home in the dark again, and the site remembered that half.
